result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but the bottom navigation bar has a visible defect: a dark horizontal bar overlaps the search and orders icons, obscuring them. Other elements (header, promo banner, carousels, restaurant cards) render correctly; the partially visible third carousel item and bottom pizza card are expected scrolling behavior.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, a dark horizontal line/bar (likely a misplaced active-tab indicator or divider) is drawn across the middle of the bar, overlapping and partially hiding the search icon and the orders/receipt icon between the home and profile tabs.
issues.suggestion: Fix the positioning of the indicator/divider so it does not overlap the tab icons (e.g., place it above the tab row or under the active tab only), and ensure each nav icon is fully visible with its own tap target.

issues.description: Bottom navigation tabs have no text labels, only icons, and the home tab is the only one highlighted; the obscured middle icons make it hard to identify what those tabs do.
issues.suggestion: Add short text labels under each nav icon and ensure the active state is clearly distinguishable.
